title: Account Manager
description:
**Company Description**
RKV Cargo Movers Pvt Ltd is a third-party logistics provider offering innovative transport and supply chain solutions across PAN India. The company leverages advanced IT-enabled GSM/GPS technology to track trucks in real time and address complex logistics challenges that span systems and processes. With strong roots in road transport, RKV has built a brand known for deep customer focus and flexible solutions tailored to diverse business needs. The organization is committed to delivering with speed, safety, and reliable service, ensuring consignments reach their destination within guaranteed timelines. Team members join a culture that values accountability, problem-solving, and high service standards.

**Role Description**
The Account Manager role at RKV Cargo Movers Pvt Ltd is a full-time, on-site position based in Hosur. The Account Manager will manage key customer accounts, oversee daily coordination of shipments, and ensure that service commitments are met in alignment with company standards. Responsibilities include handling client communication, tracking consignments using GSM/GPS systems, resolving service issues, and preparing regular status reports. The role also involves collaborating with operations, dispatch, and billing teams to address customer requirements, optimize routes, and support timely deliveries. The Account Manager will contribute to strengthening customer relationships, identifying opportunities for service improvement, and supporting business growth within assigned accounts.

**Qualifications**

* Strong account management and customer relationship skills, including experience handling client queries, resolving issues, and maintaining service quality.
* Knowledge of logistics, transportation, or supply chain operations, with the ability to coordinate with operations and dispatch teams.
* Comfort with IT-enabled tools and tracking systems (e.g., GSM/GPS), and proficiency in basic office software such as spreadsheets, email, and reporting tools.
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to present information clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Attention to detail, problem-solving capability, and a proactive approach to meeting delivery timelines and service guarantees.
* Ability to work on-site in Hosur, manage multiple accounts, and collaborate in a fast-paced environment.
* Relevant education in business, logistics, or a related field; prior experience in account management or logistics is an advantage.

* Lead small projects and coordinate resource allocation to meet customer and business objectives.

+ Own the processing of all domestic Sales orders in M3 – accurate and on time – for Factory warehouse, 3PL warehouse and all C&F locations.

+ Act as the contact point for the domestic Sales team; handle spot and urgent requirements and prioritise based on stock and customer commitment.
+ Keep the Sales team informed in real time on order status, stock position, QC release and expected delivery; inform delays in advance, not after the event.
+ Coordinate with Planning, Production and QC on stock availability and QC release for open orders.
+ Review open and overdue orders daily and drive them to closure; know the status of every open order at fingertip level.
+ Lead and monitor order processing at C&F, Factory warehouse and 3PL warehouse; ensure billed goods are dispatched the same day.
+ Track deliveries and proof of delivery; resolve transit and delivery issues with transporters and C&F.
+ Manage customer returns end to end – approval, physical receipt, QC check, stock posting and credit note – in coordination with Sales, QC and Finance.
+ Handle customer complaints on short, damaged, wrong or delayed deliveries; find the root cause, close within timeline and track complaint trends.
+ Own secondary freight cost; review freight rates, vehicle utilisation and load/route planning to optimise cost.
+ Verify transporter and C&F freight bills before submission to Finance; track freight cost against budget.
+ Ensure full compliance in invoicing, returns and credit notes – e-invoice, e-way bill, LR copy, POD, gate entry and credit notes as per GST rules and company policy.
+ Ensure domestic pricing in M3 is correct and as per the approved price list; no invoice to be raised at a wrong price.
+ Keep records audit-ready and support ISO, Customer, Worldwide Internal and GST audits; close audit observations on time.
+ Ensure zero difference between book stock and physical stock at all distribution warehouses.
+ Act as key user of M3 for domestic order management; own KAI ERP testing and follow up system issues with IT.
+ Share regular reports on OTIF, secondary freight cost, complaints, returns and open orders.
+ Lead, guide and monitor the Executive and order processing teams; ensure proper backup so that operations do not stop in anyone’s absence.
+ Escalate critical issues to the Sr. Manager with facts and proposed solutions.
+ Identify process gaps, implement best practices and contribute to SOPs for customer service and domestic logistics.
+ Collaborate with the Sales team to gather and review customer order details.
+ Ensure accurate and timely processing of customer orders in the system.
+ Proactively inform the Sales team about the stock position and potential delays to avoid stock-out situations.
+ Coordinate with relevant departments to confirm product availability and delivery timelines.
+ Work closely with logistics partners and internal teams to organize and optimize domestic transportation of goods.
+ Monitor shipment schedules, track deliveries, and address any logistical challenges that may arise.
+ Manage 3rd party depot operations for order management and ensure timely delivery.
+ Collaborate with the Planning and C&F team to ensure efficient stock management and timely dispatch of products.
+ Act as a liaison between the Sales team and internal departments to facilitate clear communication and understanding of customer requirements.
+ Provide real-time updates to the Sales team regarding order status, stock availability, and potential delays.
+ Proactively communicate any issues or challenges that may impact the order fulfillment process.
+ Address and resolve any issues related to order fulfillment or logistics, working proactively to find solutions.
+ Escalate complex issues to higher management when necessary and provide recommendations for improvement.
+ Maintain accurate records of customer orders, shipments, and logistics activities.
+ Ensure compliance with all documentation requirements for domestic shipments.
+ Document and track customer complaints and transit insurance claims for reporting and analysis.
+ Continuously evaluate and identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of customer service and logistics processes.
+ Implement best practices and contribute to the development of standard operating procedures

**Qualifications**

* Graduate (MBA / PG in Supply Chain preferred) with 10+ years of experience in Customer Services and Logistics, preferably in a manufacturing or 3PL company.
* Hands-on experience in domestic order processing, C&F / 3PL operations and transport management.
* Working knowledge of M3 or similar ERP and GST documentation (e-invoice, e-way bill).

 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
